question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Intransigence
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Compromise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intransigence"** refers to a stubborn refusal to change one's views or to agree to something. (अड़ियलपन, जिद)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager's intransigence made it difficult to reach a consensus during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Compromise"** refers to an agreement or settlement of a dispute that is reached by each side making concessions. (समझौता)
 
 
• **Example:** After long discussions, both parties agreed to a compromise to resolve their differences.
 
 
 
• Since "Compromise" is the opposite of "Intransigence," it is the most appropriate antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Compromise)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Obstinacy** (हठ): The quality of being stubborn and refusing to change one's opinion or course of action.

 
 
• **Example:** His obstinacy in refusing to apologize caused the argument to escalate.
 
 
 
• **Defiance** (उल्लंघन): Open resistance or bold disobedience.
 
 
• **Example:** The student showed defiance by refusing to follow the teacher's instructions.
 
 
 
• **Rigidity** (कठोरता): The inability to be changed or adapted; inflexibility.
 
 
• **Example:** The rigidity of the rules made it challenging for the employees to adapt to changes.
